MentionBird - Find out why AI recommends your competitor — then fix it. | Product Hunt [...] Yes — that's the core of the feature. Scope to a competitor, exclude yourself, and you get those answers plus every source feeding them, ranked by citation count with an ownership label on each.

What does it mean when my own page is cited in an answer that names a competitor?

It means AI read your page and still recommended someone else — usually because the page doesn't state clearly what you do, who you're for, or how you compare. These are the fastest wins available, because you already control the page.

Which platforms does the comparison cover? [...] Being named is not the same as winning

A brand can be named in almost every answer and still hold a small slice of the shortlist, because the others are named too and ranked higher. Mention rate and share move independently. Tracking only one of them hides the problem.

Averages hide the answers that matter

One share number across every prompt tells you nothing about the three questions closest to purchase. Your competitor may be losing overall and winning exactly where buyers decide.

A competitor's lead sits on pages, not on their brand

AI names the brands its sources describe. Your rival's advantage is the set of pages that describe them — which is a list you can read, and work on.

results.title: 6 Peec AI Alternatives Compared: Which Tool Matches Your Execution Model? | Spike AI
results.content: MentionBird connects AI visibility tracking with specific recommendations for each buyer prompt. It checks selected prompts daily across supported AI platforms and countries. Teams can review mention rate, average position, visibility share, citations, and competitor performance. Its main advantage over Peec AI is the action behind each result. MentionBird reviews the exact AI answer, cited sources, and competing brands. It then recommends clear work, such as improving product pages, publishing guides, adding schema, or pitching trusted reviewers. Each suggestion includes reasoning, source links, and an effort estimate. Teams can also export data or connect it with ChatGPT, Claude, etc.
